title: Lawyer: Puka Nacua will be available for all Rams 2026 OTAs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lawyer: Puka Nacua will be available for all Rams 2026 OTAs
sources.description: In the aftermath of the disclosure by attorney Levi McCathern that Rams receiver Puka Nacua has entered rehab, McCathern has issued a full statement regarding the development.
